scripts.build:pkjs: npm run typecheck:pkjs && npm run bundle:pkjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run gen:tsconfig && tsc && npm run typecheck:pkjs
scripts.build: npm run gen:tsconfig && tsc --noEmit && npm run build:pkjs
scripts.build:pebble: pebble clean && npm run build && pebble build
scripts.check: oxfmt --check src/embeddedjs src/pkjs && npm run lint
scripts.fix: npm run format && oxlint --fix src/embeddedjs src/pkjs
scripts.clean:emu: pebble kill; pkill -f '[q]emu-pebble' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f '[p]ypkjs' 2>/dev/null; rm -f /tmp/pb-emulator.json ~/.pebble-sdk/*/emery/qemu_spi_flash.bin "${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/pebble-sdk/"*/emery/qemu_spi_flash.bin; sleep 2
scripts.install:emery: npm run build:pebble || exit $?; trap 'exit 130' INT; npm run clean:emu; for i in 1 2 3; do timeout 60 pebble install --emulator emery -v && exec pebble logs --emulator emery -v; npm run clean:emu; done; exit 1
scripts.install:phone: npm run build:pebble || exit $?; test -n "$PHONE_IP" || { echo 'usage: PHONE_IP=192.168.1.42 npm run install:phone  (LAN dev connection IP shown in the Pebble app)'; exit 1; }; exec pebble install --phone "$PHONE_IP"
